verified_source_findings.fact: Creation selects v8, history_chapters=128, recent_complete_chapters=2, max_characters=null and queries=[]. freeze_working_context consumes the policy queries without deriving them from the chapter task. v8 keeps complete recent chapters and older query or located-memory matches.

Missing, invalid and empty observations remain explicit source-coverage gaps. Current observations preserve perspective, knowledge owner and causal closure. With empty queries and no located memory, relevant older prose can remain unselected despite preserved source identity.

verified_source_findings.fact: The complete selected-source manifest, source resolution and dependency checks are separate from the visible passage list. These are reusable provenance boundaries; retaining a manifest does not prove the model received or understood its prose.

adapt.mechanism: Retrieve event/state-change summaries and unresolved-thread history from the current task; refine selection after the chapter memo exists.
Select relevant current-state facts, roles and planning sections; retain the origin and latest meaningful change for explicitly referenced threads.
Derive source-bound memory from written events, preserve unrelated state, and reread exact source revisions when needed.

do_not_copy: planning-materials.readPreviousEndingExcerpt currently returns the complete previous chapter, which Planner marks protected.

necessary_verification: A frozen task recalls an older CJK/English passage without memory; changed task identity does not reuse the wrong projection.
Ending continuity remains readable without requiring a full long predecessor chapter; a same-scene source can be expanded through explicit evidence needs.
Belief, hearsay, reader-only scope, exact source identity, quotation coverage and recursive causes survive selection.
Planning and Chapter native entry points actually freeze and deliver the intended task projection; replay preserves it and later source edits invalidate only their dependencies.
Frozen v2-v8 inputs retain original semantics and hashes; no saved draft, active plan, accepted frontier or cancelled/unknown execution is rewritten.
Measure identical consumer requests before and after, with retained relevant evidence, actual omitted ranges and full-request capacity; shorter text alone is not a semantic or literary pass.
verified_source_findings_scope: These findings remain the original preimplementation review of Novel Forge 215abd7d0abf4a158d7454ed72237486d201b040; they do not describe the later v9 default.
review_recommendations: Derive retrieval demand from the exact frozen stage task and bind stage, target and task/source hashes; do not mutate v2-v8 frozen requests or selected author policies.
Retrieve source-bound CJK and English relevant paragraphs even when optional memory is missing; keep explicit query support and honest unmatched/omitted evidence.
Use an attributed ending scene or paragraph window for immediate prose continuity instead of requiring recent chapters in full; do not infer scene semantics from punctuation alone.
Retain selected observations, knowledge boundaries and the full located causal support needed by those observations.
Keep full original manuscripts available for exact reread; keep summaries and retrieval metadata out of fictional duties and prose.
Preserve current active fictional plans. Expose any necessary story change to the existing authorized Planning/Plan Change owner rather than silently rewriting it.

implementation_followup.task_sources: Exact current ChapterPlan for Chapter execution; frozen Arc inputs and the parent ChapterGroup current Chapter-function row for ChapterPlan generation/validation; Arc inputs without its own Group output for ChapterGroup generation. Each path also binds the Book input snapshot CHARACTER_CAST; only unique character tokens expand referenced subjects.
implementation_followup.selection: Deterministic local CJK/English retrieval, predecessor ending units, selected scoped observations and recursive original causal support. Single-newline/CRLF and overlong paragraphs retain exact Unicode source ranges; unit boundaries do not assert complete scenes.
implementation_followup.ownership: Existing Book freeze and verification UoW, Planning Arc Working Set, Chapter submission/regeneration and Context consumers; no new database, role or state owner.
implementation_followup.compatibility: Frozen v2-v8 requests retain their original policies, paragraph segmentation and source semantics.
implementation_followup.limit: Source integration does not prove PostgreSQL execution, real Provider consumption, complete semantic recall or literary improvement.

historical_design_trace.finding: v2 explicitly mandates complete recent chapters to retain selected unaccepted working experience; completeness is a policy, not a narrative invariant.
Paragraph selection fills remaining allocation even with zero query relevance. Later v6/v7 capacity allocation equals total source characters, admitting eligible full historical prose.
v8 removes unselected historical fill, but task demand is not derived into the default empty query list; missing optional observations leave older facts undiscovered.
